title: Decorators add behaviour
summary: A decorator wraps a function with extra behaviour. The original function can stay focused on its job.
introduction: A decorator wraps a function with extra behaviour. The original function can stay focused on its job. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Make a wrapper that adds a star before the greeting.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Too many wrappers can hide the order in which work happens.
